name: ThirdShotHub Baseline Control 14
description: The ThirdShotHub Baseline Control 14 is the house-brand control paddle, built for players who win points at the kitchen line rather than off the baseline. A raw T700 carbon face generates spin on touch shots, and the 14 mm core is tuned soft so dinks drop short instead of sitting up. It is the paddle ThirdShotHub recommends to 3.0-3.5 players moving off a starter paddle for the first time.
care_instructions: Wipe the raw carbon face with a damp cloth after every session — raw faces hold ball residue that dulls spin within a few hours of play. Do not use alcohol or solvent cleaners, which strip the peel-ply texture. Store below 90F; a hot car trunk will soften the core bond. Edge guard is user-replaceable under the 18-month warranty.
